entries.updatedReason: Institution identity remains unresolved after a second, deeper pass. Wikipedia has no article under 'Sakartvelo University'/'University Sakartvelo' (confirmed via the Wikipedia opensearch API - zero matches). No official .edu.ge or similar domain could be guessed and verified (tried sakartvelo.edu.ge, sakartvelouni.edu.ge, sau.edu.ge, usu.edu.ge - none resolve). A distinct institution, University Geomedi (geomedi.edu.ge), does exist in Georgia and was already resolved in an earlier batch under the slug 'university-geomedi' - this record is NOT the same institution and should not inherit its assets. This looks like an unresolved-identity / possible duplicate-or-mistranslated-name record ('Sakartvelo' is simply the Georgian word for 'Georgia') rather than a source-availability problem; recommend a data/identity review of this specific 'Faculty of Medicine' record before further media research is attempted.

entries.updatedReason: Checked the official uit.edu.vn homepage and its dedicated 'gioi-thieu-chung' (general introduction/about) page directly. All homepage/carousel banners found (uit_bannerweb_gioithieu_02.jpg, uit_bannerweb_20nam.png, uit_bannerweb_tuyensinh.png, banner_kiem_dinh.png) are stylized marketing graphics with overlaid slogan text and/or the same '20 năm' (20-year anniversary, 2006-2026) badge already flagged in the first pass - none is genuine unstaged campus photography. The about page's own inline images are only small decorative icons (max 223x226px), not cover-quality. No press/media/brand-kit page link was found on the site. Remains held; did not substitute a marketing graphic or a low-resolution icon.

Re-confirmed via the Wikipedia opensearch API that no article exists for 'University of Legia' or 'Legia and Company' (closest fuzzy matches are unrelated: Legrand (company), Leggo and Company, University of Leicester, etc.) - consistent with the first pass's finding of only thin, speculative third-party directory listings and no verifiable official domain. No new identity information was found in this pass. This remains an unresolved-identity record, not a source-availability problem; no logo or cover is nominated.
